channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Waterspouts form over Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian as severe weather hits Treasure Coast
item.description: Severe weather on Friday brought waterspouts over the Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian, heavy rain in Port St. Lucie, and lightning strikes that caused a brush fire and possible house fire.

item.title: JetBlue ending Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9, citing low demand.

item.title: Boynton Beach firefighters rescue dog from raw sewage lift station
item.description: Boynton Beach Fire Rescue Department crews rescued a dog that fell roughly 10 to 12 feet into a lift station holding about 2 feet of raw sewage Thursday.

item.title: Wellington teen recovering after e-bike rider strikes him near Lion Country Safari
item.description: A Wellington teenager is recovering from multiple injuries after he says he was struck by an electric bike rider while heading home from work on his electric scooter Tuesday night near Lion Country Safari.

item.title: Boynton Beach police arrest Boca Raton man for soliciting videos from minor, believe more victims possible
item.description: A 51-year-old Boca Raton man was arrested for soliciting videos from a minor after asking a 14-year-old for videos, according to Boynton Beach police.

item.title: West Palm Beach VA Healthcare System hosts resource fair for veterans at Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Loxahatchee
item.description: The West Palm Beach VA Healthcare System hosted a resource fair for veterans on Friday at Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Loxahatchee.

item.title: Severe weather strikes Treasure Coast with waterspouts, lightning fires and injuries
item.description: Severe weather battered the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County on Friday, spawning waterspouts, lightning strikes and multiple fires. item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 to advance to World Cup final
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with two late goals to reach Sunday's final against Spain.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record in London
item.description: The 27-year-old runner shattered a mark that stood since 1999, running 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event Saturday.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final at New Jersey stadium Sunday
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement and private companies have spent two years preparing for the Argentina-Spain match, which President Trump will attend.

item.title: Messi bathed Spain's Yamal as baby, now they meet in World Cup final
item.description: A 2007 photo shoot for a charity calendar paired a teenage Lionel Messi with infant Lamine Yamal, who now faces Argentina at age 19.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent AI decisions
item.description: Teams can no longer access custom tabs on tablets that provided recommendations on substitutions, pitch calling and other in-game decisions.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from the local facility finished in the top 15 at AAU Nationals and earned a spot at the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.
